name: Bring the End
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
In the Barrens lies a horrid mess of tangled vines called Razorfen Downs. While our first observations of this place revealed little threat, our recent findings are much more serious...

The quilboar of Razorfen Downs have aligned themselves with the Scourge. A Lich named Amnennar the Coldbringer rules them now, using the power of his massive consciousness to control their every move.

Amnennar has a direct telepathic link to Ner'zhul; we must sever this bond, adventurer. An end must come to the Coldbringer.
narrative.objectives: Andrew Brownell wants you to kill Amnennar the Coldbringer and return his skull.
narrative.offerRewardText: The loyalty of a Lich is unswerving, adventurer. Let them know that such loyalty will only bring them destruction.
narrative.requestItemsText: This matter is of utmost importance, adventurer. We must stop any attempt by the Scourge to bolster their ranks.

objectiveItems.name: Skull of the Coldbringer
sources: Amnennar the Coldbringer in Razorfen Downs
